description: This file defines the UnrewindableStreamException class within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace, which extends RuntimeException and implements ExceptionInterface. It provides a static method to create an exception indicating that callback streams cannot be rewinded.

classes.name: UnrewindableStreamException
classes.description: A specialized exception class indicating that a stream cannot be rewound, specifically used for callback streams.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: A static factory method that creates an instance of this exception with a specific message indicating callback streams cannot rewind.
